missions.title: ROOFTOP OF THE REITZ
missions.objective: Climb the Reitz Union to its penthouse roof, 28.8 m!
missions.hint: Start on the ravine side and use the terraces and window-washer lift to reach the tower roof.

missions.title: MEAL SWIPE TOKENS
missions.objective: Find the 8 meal-swipe tokens around the quad!
missions.hint: Follow the quad route and check elevated spots as well as ground level.

missions.title: REMOTE ROBOTICS LAB - 2P
missions.objective: One drives the crane, one rides it up to the ledge!
missions.hint: The rider jumps into each yellow sensor box to open a gate while the driver lines up the crane.

missions.title: OUT-OF-ORDER ELEVATOR
missions.objective: The elevator's broken! Climb the atrium to the 5th floor!
missions.hint: Use the atrium stairs and book-cart lifts to climb toward the fifth floor.

missions.title: SHHH! LOST TEXTBOOKS
missions.objective: Find 8 lost textbooks on the silent 5th floor. Shhh!
missions.hint: Hold L to tiptoe on the fifth floor, and keep an eye on the librarian patrols.

missions.title: STUDY ROOM BOOKING - 2P
missions.objective: Swap booking codes, then book every kiosk within 4 s!
missions.hint: Coordinate the kiosk punches with your teammates; the booking window is only four seconds.
